description: This Java source file defines the class DefaultCardStreamAnimator, which extends CardStreamAnimator and provides animated behaviors for a card stream UI component in an Android application. Its methods generate ObjectAnimator instances for various animations such as appearing, disappearing, swiping in, and swiping out, with customizable properties like alpha, translation, rotation, and duration.

classes.name: DefaultCardStreamAnimator
classes.description: A class providing animated transitions for card stream items, including appearance, disappearance, and swipe animations, leveraging Android's ObjectAnimator and PropertyValuesHolder.

methods.name: getDisappearingAnimator
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator that fades out, scales down, and rotates the card for disappearing animation.

methods.name: getAppearingAnimator
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator that animates the card appearing from the middle of the screen with fade-in and rotation.

methods.name: getInitalAnimator
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator that sets the initial state of the card, with partial opacity and rotation.

methods.name: getSwipeInAnimator
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator for a swipe-in effect of a view with bounce interpolator, changing alpha, translationX, and rotationY.

methods.name: getSwipeOutAnimator
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator for swipe-out effect, translating and rotating the view out of the screen with fade-out.
